verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents a management API with two authentication methods: environment secret keys and personal access tokens. It also documents a client for targeting multiple projects and environments, SDK calls to trigger runs, and run handles that let you check status, cancel and retry programmatically. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), an endpoint-level REST reference in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the platform through the API.
